Diagnosis.submission: The user-service deployment has been misconfigured with dnsPolicy: None and dnsConfig pointing to nameserver 8.8.8.8 (Google public DNS) instead of the cluster-internal DNS server. This breaks all Kubernetes service name resolution for the user-service pod. As a result, the user-service cannot resolve the jaeger hostname during startup, gets stuck in an infinite retry loop in SetUpTracer (tracing.h:164), and never starts its Thrift RPC server on port 9090. All dependent services (compose-post-service, nginx-thrift API gateway) fail with Connection refused when attempting to call user-service endpoints such as RegisterUser and Login.
